note: D-8 第一批流程卡草稿。內容由網路搜尋讀取官方頁面整理（政府與學校網站無法直接連線，沒有逐字核對原文）；匯入後是未發布草稿，需審查者逐一開啟來源核對、修正後才發布並記錄驗證。uncertain 是需要確認的地方。

cards.title_zh: 外國學生首次申請外僑居留證（ARC）
cards.title_en: First Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) Application for Foreign Students
cards.description_zh: 外國學生入國後，須於入國翌日起算30日內，透過移民署學生線上申辦系統申請外僑居留證。持居留簽證或就學事由之停留簽證入國者都適用；持停留簽證者另須附健康檢查合格證明，並加收規費。核准後繳費，再列印電子居留證，或到指定服務站領取晶片居留證。
cards.description_en: Foreign students must apply for an ARC within 30 days, counted from the day after entry, through the NIA's online system for students. This applies to students who entered on a resident visa or on a visitor visa issued for study. Visitor-visa entrants must also submit a health certificate and pay an extra fee. After approval you pay the fee, then either print an e-ARC or collect a chip card at your designated service station.
cards.applicable_to: 經各級主管教育行政機關核定得招收外國學生之學校許可在臺就學的外國學生（含持居留簽證，或持就學事由停留簽證入國者）；僑生適用同一送件須知，規費減半
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign students admitted by a school approved to enroll foreign students, whether they entered on a resident visa or on a visitor visa issued for study. Overseas compatriot students follow the same guideline and pay half the fee.
cards.location: 移民署學生線上申辦系統；晶片居留證到申請時指定的移民署服務站領取（例如臺中市第一服務站：臺中市南屯區文心南三路22號1樓）
cards.location_en: NIA online system for students; collect the chip card at the service station you choose (e.g. Taichung City First Service Station)

steps.notes: 適用對象是經主管教育行政機關核定可招收外國學生的學校所許可就學的學生，以及僑生等[1][3]。應於入國翌日起算30日內申請居留[1][4]。沒有在期限內申請的，處新臺幣2,000元以上10,000元以下罰鍰[1][4]。
steps.notes_en: This applies to students admitted by schools that the education authorities have approved to enrol foreign students, and to overseas compatriot students and others[1][3]. Apply for residence within 30 days, counted from the day after you enter Taiwan[1][4]. Missing the deadline can bring a fine of NT$2,000 to NT$10,000[1][4].

steps.notes: 共同文件：護照、最近二年內二吋半身脫帽正面相片（規格同國民身分證相片）[1][3]。個別文件：居留簽證或就學事由之停留簽證、入學許可或一個月內的在學證明（含學生證）、在臺居留住址證明[1][3]。持停留簽證者另附最近三個月內的健康檢查合格證明[1][3]。
steps.notes_en: Documents for everyone: your passport and a 2-inch, bare-headed, front-facing photo taken within the last two years (same rules as Taiwanese ID photos)[1][3]. Your own documents: a resident visa or a visitor visa issued for study, your admission letter or a certificate of enrollment issued within one month (a student ID also works), and proof of your address in Taiwan[1][3]. If you hold a visitor visa, also attach a health certificate issued within the last three months[1][3].

steps.notes: 到移民署「外國與外僑、大陸與港澳、無戶籍國民學生線上申辦系統」註冊帳號，填寫申請書並上傳文件[1][2]。申請時要選定日後領證的服務站[1]。系統操作問題可洽移民署客服專線02-2796-7162（週一至週五8:30–17:30）或CSservice@immigration.gov.tw；案件問題請洽學校所在地服務站[3]。
steps.notes_en: Register an account on the NIA's online application system for foreign, overseas Chinese, mainland, Hong Kong and Macao students, then fill in the application and upload your documents[1][2]. When you apply, choose the service station where you will collect your card[1]. For help using the system, call the NIA helpline 02-2796-7162 (Mon–Fri 8:30–17:30) or email CSservice@immigration.gov.tw; for questions about your case, contact the service station near your school[3].

steps.title_en: Wait for review; supplement if asked
steps.notes: 審查約需五個工作天[1][2]。資料不符或欠缺時，應於接到通知後15日內補正，審查天數從補正後重新計算[1]。
steps.notes_en: Review takes about five working days[1][2]. If something is wrong or missing, you must fix it within 15 days of being told, and the review time starts again after you do[1].

steps.notes: 審核通過後應於五個工作天內繳費[2]。規費為每件每一年效期新臺幣1,000元[1][2][3]。持停留簽證入國申請者加收新臺幣2,200元[1][2][3]；僑生減半[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: Pay within five working days after approval[2]. The fee is NT$1,000 per year of validity[1][2][3]. If you entered on a visitor visa, there is an extra NT$2,200[1][2][3]; overseas compatriot students pay half[1][2].

steps.title_zh: 列印電子證或領取晶片卡
steps.title_en: Print the e-ARC or collect the chip card
steps.notes: 居留效期六個月的電子居留證，可在系統上下載列印[1][2]。晶片居留證：在系統下載列印線上繳款收據，三個工作日後持收據到申請時指定的服務站領取[1][2]。臺中市第一服務站位於臺中市南屯區文心南三路22號1樓，電話(04)2472-5103[5]。
steps.notes_en: An e-ARC valid for six months can be downloaded and printed from the system[1][2]. For the chip ARC card, download and print your online payment receipt, then collect the card with the receipt at the service station you chose, three working days later[1][2]. The Taichung City First Service Station is at 1F, No. 22, Wenxin S. 3rd Rd., Nantun Dist., Taichung, tel. (04)2472-5103[5].

cards.title_zh: 外國學生外僑居留證延期
cards.title_en: Extending the ARC for Foreign Students
cards.description_zh: 仍在學的外國學生，應在外僑居留證效期屆滿前三個月內，透過移民署學生線上申辦系統申請延期。需上傳護照、相片、在學證明及住址證明，核准後繳費並領取新證。逾期居留會被處罰，逾期30日以上還須出國重新申請簽證。
cards.description_en: Foreign students who are still enrolled should apply to extend their ARC within the three months before it expires, using the NIA online system for students. Upload your passport, a photo, an enrollment certificate and proof of address, then pay and collect the new card after approval. Overstaying is penalized; overstaying 30 days or more means leaving Taiwan and applying for a new visa.
cards.applicable_to: 已持有外僑居留證、仍在核定學校就學的外國學生（僑生適用同一須知，規費減半）
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign students who already hold an ARC and are still enrolled at an approved school (overseas compatriot students follow the same guideline at half the fee)
cards.location: 移民署學生線上申辦系統；晶片居留證到申請時指定的移民署服務站領取
cards.location_en: NIA online system for students; chip cards are collected at the service station chosen during the application

steps.title_zh: 在到期前三個月內申請
steps.notes: 外僑居留證延期應在居留效期屆滿前三個月內申辦[1][4]。逾期居留未滿30日、原居留原因仍存在的，依規定處罰後可以重新申請居留；逾期30日以上的，處罰後須出國，再重新申請簽證入國[1][4]。
steps.notes_en: Apply to extend your ARC within the three months before it expires[1][4]. If you have overstayed for less than 30 days and your original reason for residence still applies, you can apply again after paying the penalty; if you have overstayed 30 days or more, you must leave Taiwan after the penalty and apply for a new visa[1][4].

steps.title_zh: 申請一個月內的在學證明
steps.notes: 需要入學許可或一個月內的在學證明（含學生證）、在臺居留住址證明，以及護照、最近二年內二吋半身脫帽正面相片[1][3]。在學證明有一個月時效，請在送件前不久再申請。
steps.notes_en: You need your admission letter or a certificate of enrollment issued within one month (a student ID also works), proof of your address in Taiwan, your passport, and a 2-inch, bare-headed, front-facing photo taken within the last two years[1][3]. The certificate of enrollment is only valid for one month, so request it shortly before you apply.

steps.title_zh: 登入系統送出延期申請
steps.notes: 登入移民署「外國與外僑、大陸與港澳、無戶籍國民學生線上申辦系統」，填寫申請書並上傳文件[1][2]。審查約需五個工作天；資料欠缺時應於接到通知後15日內補正[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: Log in to the NIA's online application system for students, fill in the application and upload your documents[1][2]. Review takes about five working days; if anything is missing, fix it within 15 days of being told[1][2].

steps.notes: 審核通過後五個工作天內繳費[2]。規費為每件每一年效期新臺幣1,000元，僑生減半[1][2][3]。
steps.notes_en: Pay within five working days after approval[2]. The fee is NT$1,000 per year of validity; overseas compatriot students pay half[1][2][3].

steps.title_en: Collect the new card and return the old one
steps.notes: 居留效期六個月的電子居留證可線上下載列印[1][2]。晶片居留證：列印繳款收據，三個工作日後持收據到指定服務站領取；延期者領證時須繳回舊證[1]。
steps.notes_en: An e-ARC valid for six months can be downloaded and printed online[1][2]. For the chip card, print your payment receipt and collect the card with it at your chosen service station three working days later; when extending, hand back your old card when you collect the new one[1].

cards.title_zh: 外僑居留證遺失或污損補發
cards.title_en: Replacing a Lost or Damaged ARC
cards.description_zh: 外僑居留證遺失、滅失或污損時，可以向移民署申請補發，補發須重新製證，每件規費新臺幣500元。遺失補發要附遺失具結書或報案證明。可以線上申辦，也可以臨櫃辦理，並可委託他人代辦。
cards.description_en: If your ARC is lost, destroyed or damaged, apply to the NIA for a replacement. A new card is produced and the fee is NT$500. For a lost card, attach a signed loss declaration or a police report. You can apply online or at a service counter, and someone else can apply on your behalf.
cards.applicable_to: 外僑居留證遺失、滅失或污損的外國人（包含外國學生）
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign nationals, including foreign students, whose ARC is lost, destroyed or damaged
cards.location: 移民署線上申辦，或移民署各服務站臨櫃辦理
cards.location_en: NIA online application, or in person at an NIA service station

steps.title_zh: 取得遺失具結書或報案證明
steps.title_en: Get a loss declaration or police report
steps.notes: 申請遺失補發時，須附遺失具結書或報案證明（二擇一）[3]。
steps.notes_en: To replace a lost card, attach either a signed loss declaration or a police report[3].

steps.title_en: Prepare your passport and a photo
steps.notes: 共同文件為護照及最近二年內二吋半身脫帽正面相片[1]。臨櫃申請時繳驗護照正本並留存影本[3]。
steps.notes_en: Everyone needs a passport and a 2-inch, bare-headed, front-facing photo taken within the last two years[1]. If you apply at a counter, show your original passport and leave a copy[3].

steps.title_en: Apply online or at a counter
steps.notes: 線上以本人帳號申請視同本人申請，上傳護照電子檔，並附遺失具結書或報案證明[3]。以他人帳號申請時，另上傳委託書及受委託人身分證件[3]。臨櫃委託他人辦理時，須附委託書正本並出示受委託人身分證件[3]。
steps.notes_en: Applying online with your own account counts as applying in person: upload your passport and attach the loss declaration or police report[3]. If someone applies with their account on your behalf, also upload a letter of authorization and that person's ID[3]. If someone applies at a counter for you, they need the original letter of authorization and their own ID[3].

steps.notes: 外僑居留證污損、滅失或遺失補發，每件新臺幣500元，須重新製證[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: Replacing a damaged, destroyed or lost ARC costs NT$500, and a new card is made[1][2].

cards.title_zh: 外籍生居留健康檢查與新生健檢
cards.title_en: Residence health certificate and freshman health check
cards.description_zh: 申請居留簽證，或持就學目的停留簽證在臺改辦居留時，須繳交衛福部規定的「居留或定居健康檢查」合格證明，報告3個月內有效，可在疾管署公告的指定醫院受檢。另外，逢甲境外新生還要參加學校安排的新生健康檢查，兩者項目不同、不能互相替代。
cards.description_en: Students applying for a resident visa, or switching from a study-purpose visitor visa to residence in Taiwan, must submit a passing Health Certificate for Residence Application, valid for 3 months, from a CDC-designated hospital (or an authenticated overseas hospital). FCU's overseas freshmen must also take the university's own health check; the two cannot replace each other.
cards.applicable_to: 申請居留簽證或在臺改辦居留的外籍學生（例如持就學目的停留簽證入境者）；逢甲境外新生（校內新生健檢）
cards.applicable_to_en: International students applying for a resident visa or switching to residence in Taiwan; FCU overseas freshmen (on-campus check)
cards.location: 疾管署公告的外國人健檢指定醫院（臺中市有9家），或駐外館處認定的國外醫院；校內新生健檢依逢甲公告
cards.location_en: CDC-designated hospitals in Taiwan (9 in Taichung) or overseas hospitals recognized by Taiwan's missions; the freshman check follows FCU's notice

steps.title_zh: 確認自己需要哪一種健檢
steps.title_en: Find out which health check you need
steps.notes: 在國外申請居留簽證，或持就學目的停留簽證入境、在臺改辦居留的學生，都必須繳驗最近3個月內的合格健康證明[7]。用免簽、落地簽、電子簽證或非就學目的停留簽證入境的人，不能以就學為由改辦居留[7]。逢甲說明，持停留簽證的學生申辦居留證時需要附居留健檢報告[9]。
steps.notes_en: Students who apply for a resident visa abroad, or who enter on a visitor visa for study and change to residence in Taiwan, must show a passing health certificate issued within the last three months[7]. People who entered visa-free, on a landing visa, an eVisa or a visitor visa for another purpose cannot change to residence for study[7]. FCU explains that students on a visitor visa need the residence health check report when they apply for their ARC[9].

steps.title_zh: 下載居留健康檢查項目表
steps.title_en: Download the residence health certificate form
steps.notes: 使用疾管署公告的中英對照「居留或定居健康檢查項目表」[1][2]。檢查項目：胸部X光肺結核檢查、腸內寄生蟲糞便檢查、梅毒血清檢查、麻疹及德國麻疹抗體檢查或預防接種證明、漢生病檢查[2][3]。孕婦和12歲以下兒童免照胸部X光，15歲以下兒童免驗梅毒，附表所列國家或地區的人免驗糞便寄生蟲和漢生病[2][3]。
steps.notes_en: Use the Taiwan CDC's bilingual health check form for residence or settlement[1][2]. It covers a chest X-ray for tuberculosis, a stool test for intestinal parasites, a syphilis blood test, measles and rubella antibodies or proof of vaccination, and a leprosy (Hansen's disease) exam[2][3]. Pregnant women and children under 12 skip the chest X-ray, children under 15 skip the syphilis test, and people from the countries or regions listed in the appendix skip the stool and leprosy tests[2][3].

steps.title_en: Get examined at a designated hospital
steps.notes: 在臺灣受檢須到疾管署公告的「外國人健檢指定醫院」[4][7]。臺中市名單包括：臺中榮民總醫院、中國醫藥大學附設醫院、衛生福利部臺中醫院、臺中慈濟醫院、衛生福利部豐原醫院、光田綜合醫院（沙鹿總院）、童綜合醫院（梧棲院區）、李綜合醫院大甲院區、仁愛醫院大里院區；部分醫院需要預約，請先確認受理時間[4]。在國外受檢的報告須經駐外館處驗證[1][7]。檢查不合格者應先治療或接種，取得合格證明再申辦[12]。
steps.notes_en: In Taiwan, get examined at a hospital on the Taiwan CDC's list of designated hospitals for foreigners' health checks[4][7]. In Taichung these include Taichung Veterans General Hospital, China Medical University Hospital, MOHW Taichung Hospital, Taichung Tzu Chi Hospital, MOHW Feng Yuan Hospital, Kuang Tien General Hospital (Shalu), Tungs' Taichung MetroHarbor Hospital (Wuqi), Lee's General Hospital Dajia branch and Jen-Ai Hospital Dali branch. Some need an appointment, so check their hours first[4]. Reports from abroad must be authenticated by a Taiwan overseas mission[1][7]. If you fail an item, get treatment or vaccination first and apply once you have a passing certificate[12].

steps.notes: 須繳驗最近3個月內的合格健康證明；在臺改辦居留簽證約需8個工作天，須在停留期限屆滿前8個工作天以前送件[7]。拿到居留簽證後，要在30日內向移民署申請外僑居留證[7]。
steps.notes_en: You must show a passing health certificate issued within the last three months. Changing to a resident visa in Taiwan takes about eight working days, so apply at least eight working days before your permitted stay ends[7]. After you receive the resident visa, apply to the NIA for your ARC within 30 days[7].

steps.title_zh: 完成逢甲校內新生健檢
steps.title_en: Complete FCU's on-campus freshman health check
steps.notes: 逢甲規定所有境外新生都必須參加校內新生健檢，項目和居留健檢不同，不能互相替代[10][11]。2025年秋季班的作法：用NID帳號登入MYFCU填寫健康問題評估表；校內健檢費用新臺幣575元，須空腹6至8小時；錯過者可到合約醫院童綜合醫院梧棲院區補檢；在其他醫院受檢者須使用「逢甲大學學生健康資料表」[11]。每學年的日期與費用請以學校最新公告為準。
steps.notes_en: FCU requires every international freshman to take the on-campus freshman health check. It covers different items from the residence health check, so one cannot replace the other[10][11]. For fall 2025: log in to MyFCU with your NID and fill in the health questionnaire; the on-campus check costs NT$575 and you must fast for 6 to 8 hours; if you miss it, you can make it up at the partner hospital, Tungs' Taichung MetroHarbor Hospital (Wuqi); if you are examined at another hospital, use FCU's student health record form[11]. Dates and fees change each year, so follow the school's latest notice.

cards.title_zh: 加入全民健康保險（健保）與申辦健保卡
cards.title_en: Joining National Health Insurance (NHI) and getting your NHI card
cards.description_zh: 持居留證在臺就學的外籍生，在臺居留滿6個月後，依法必須以就讀學校為投保單位加入全民健保。每月自付保費目前為新臺幣826元，學校在每學期註冊時一次代收半年保費。還沒有健保資格的期間，新生必須自備至少6個月的醫療及傷害保險，或參加學校的國際學生醫療保險。
cards.description_en: Foreign degree students with an ARC must join NHI through their university once they have lived in Taiwan for 6 months. The student pays NT$826 a month, collected six months at a time with each semester's registration. Until then, new students need medical and injury insurance covering at least 6 months, either their own policy or the school's International Student Medical Insurance.
cards.applicable_to: 持有效居留證（ARC）在臺就學的外籍學位生（僑生、港澳生、陸生另有部分不同規定）
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign degree students with a valid ARC (some rules differ for overseas Chinese, Hong Kong/Macau and mainland Chinese students)
cards.location: 逢甲大學國際事務處（行政二館303室）代辦加保與健保卡申請；也可到健保署各分區業務組／聯絡辦公室臨櫃辦理健保卡
cards.location_en: FCU Office of International Affairs (Administration Building II, Room 303) handles enrollment and the first NHI card; NHI cards can also be applied for at NHIA counters

steps.title_zh: 入學時先備妥醫療及傷害保險
steps.title_en: Have medical and injury insurance when you register
steps.notes: 依《外國學生來臺就學辦法》第22條，新生註冊時要附上醫療及傷害保險證明，保單效期須從入境當天起算至少6個月；國外核發的保險證明須經我國駐外機構驗證[8]。逢甲為尚未具健保資格的外國學生與陸生提供國際學生醫療保險，每學期新臺幣3,000元或每月500元；理賠上限為門診、急診、病房費每日各1,000元，住院每次12萬元，校方建議另外在母國購買留學生保險[9][11]。
steps.notes_en: Under Article 22 of the Regulations Regarding International Students Undertaking Studies in Taiwan, new students must show medical and accident insurance when they register, valid for at least six months from the day they enter Taiwan; insurance issued abroad must be authenticated by a Taiwan overseas mission[8]. Until they qualify for NHI, FCU offers foreign and mainland students international student medical insurance at NT$3,000 per semester or NT$500 per month. It pays up to NT$1,000 a day each for outpatient visits, emergency visits and ward fees, and up to NT$120,000 per hospital stay; the school recommends also buying student insurance in your home country[9][11].

steps.title_zh: 確認何時符合健保資格
steps.title_en: Work out when you become eligible
steps.notes: 持居留證明文件的外籍人士，在臺居留滿6個月起應加入健保；「滿6個月」指連續居住6個月，或期間只出境1次且未超過30日，扣除出境天數後合計滿6個月[1][3]。例如2月1日入境都沒出境，8月1日符合資格；3月出境10天則延到8月11日[4]。受僱工作者從受僱日起由雇主加保[3]；外籍生經許可工作並受僱時，要改由工作單位投保，並向學校辦理轉出[1]。
steps.notes_en: Foreigners with a residence permit must join NHI once they have lived in Taiwan for six months. "Six months" means living here continuously, or leaving only once for no more than 30 days, with the days away subtracted[1][3]. For example, if you arrive on 1 February and never leave, you qualify on 1 August; if you are away for 10 days in March, it moves to 11 August[4]. Employees are enrolled by their employer from their first day of work[3]; if you work with a permit and are employed, your employer enrols you instead and you transfer out at the school[1].

steps.notes: 經許可在臺就學的僑外生屬第6類第2目被保險人，由就讀學校擔任投保單位[1]。逢甲國際事務處依簽證種類和出入境紀錄推算加保日[9]。在臺沒有工作，且配偶、父母或子女是健保被保險人的，也可以眷屬身分依附加保[1]。逢甲提醒，符合資格卻沒有加保，可能被處新臺幣3,000至5,000元罰鍰[10]。
steps.notes_en: International students studying in Taiwan with permission are Category 6, Subcategory 2 insured persons, and their school is the enrolling unit[1]. FCU's Office of International Affairs works out your start date from your visa type and entry and exit records[9]. If you do not work in Taiwan and your spouse, parent or child is insured, you can also be enrolled as their dependant[1]. FCU warns that not joining when you qualify can bring a fine of NT$3,000 to NT$5,000[10].

steps.title_en: Pay the premium with your tuition bill
steps.notes: 在學外籍生每月自付保費826元，衛生福利部每月另補助551元；符合清寒資格的僑生由僑委會補助413元，自付413元[2]。學校在每學期註冊時一次代收半年保費：第一學期收9月至次年2月，第二學期收3月至8月；健保費率調整時金額會跟著調整[2]。逢甲把保費列在學雜費單中，每學期4,956元[9][10]。
steps.notes_en: International students pay NT$826 a month themselves, and the Ministry of Health and Welfare adds NT$551 a month; overseas compatriot students who qualify as low-income get NT$413 from the Overseas Community Affairs Council and pay NT$413[2]. The school collects six months of premiums at registration each semester: the first semester covers September to February, the second covers March to August; the amounts change if the premium rate changes[2]. FCU puts the premium on the tuition bill: NT$4,956 per semester[9][10].

steps.notes: 完成加保後才能申請健保卡。填寫健保署「請領健保卡申請表」，黏貼一張近2年內拍攝的2吋半身、正面、脫帽、未戴有色眼鏡、五官清晰的大頭照[5][6]。首次投保時可由學校連同加保一起送件，也可以持居留證正本到健保署臨櫃辦理[5]。逢甲國際事務處會在加保後協助首次申請（校方較舊頁面寫需居留證正反面影本和照片1張）[13]。
steps.notes_en: You can apply for the NHI card only after you are enrolled. Fill in the NHIA's application form for an NHI card and attach a 2-inch, front-facing, bare-headed photo taken within the last two years, without tinted glasses and with your features clearly visible[5][6]. The first time, the school can submit it together with your enrolment, or you can apply at an NHIA counter with your original ARC[5]. FCU's Office of International Affairs helps with the first application after you are enrolled (an older school page says to bring copies of both sides of your ARC and one photo)[13].

steps.title_zh: 維持居留效期，異動時退保
steps.title_en: Keep your ARC valid and report changes
steps.notes: 居留證到期又沒有展延，健保就不能使用，請提前向移民署辦理展延[7]。居留證或簽證身分到期或變更時，需改向國際事務處申請學生團體保險；休學、退學或轉學時，要到國際事務處辦理退保與退費[9]。學校通常只投保到畢業當月，畢業後留在臺灣須自行到健保署或區公所加保[12]。
steps.notes_en: If your ARC expires and is not extended, you cannot use NHI, so extend it with the NIA in good time[7]. If your ARC or visa status expires or changes, apply for student group insurance at the Office of International Affairs instead; if you suspend your studies, withdraw or transfer, cancel your NHI and get your refund there[9]. Schools usually insure you only until the month you graduate; if you stay in Taiwan after graduating, enrol yourself at the NHIA or your district office[12].

cards.title_zh: 申請外國留學生工作許可（工讀）
cards.title_en: Applying for a Student Work Permit (Part-time Work)
cards.description_zh: 在臺就讀的外國留學生要打工，必須先取得勞動部核發的工作許可。申請一律在「外國專業人員工作許可申辦網」線上辦理，每件審查費新臺幣100元。學期中每週最多工作20小時，寒暑假不受這項限制。
cards.description_en: International students must hold a work permit from the Ministry of Labor before taking any part-time job. Apply online through the EZ Work Permit system (ezwp.wda.gov.tw); the review fee is NT$100. During the semester you may work at most 20 hours a week; the cap does not apply during winter and summer breaks.
cards.applicable_to: 正式入學修讀科、系、所課程的外國留學生（含港澳生、僑生），入學後即可申請；就讀語言課程者須修業滿6個月以上。高中（含）以下學生及大陸學生不得申請。
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign (including Hong Kong/Macau and overseas Chinese) students formally enrolled in degree programs, once enrolled; language-program students after at least 6 months of study. Not open to students at senior high level or below, or to mainland Chinese students.
cards.location: 外國專業人員工作許可申辦網（ezwp.wda.gov.tw）線上申辦；校內窗口：逢甲大學國際事務處（行政二館303室，04-24517250 分機2498，陸港澳生分機2493）
cards.location_en: Online at ezwp.wda.gov.tw; on campus: FCU Office of International Affairs (Admin Building II, Room 303, ext. 2498)

steps.title_zh: 確認自己是否具申請資格
steps.notes: 正式入學修讀科、系、所課程的學生入學後就能申請；就讀語言課程的外國學生須修業滿6個月以上[1][3]。法規另規定須經就讀學校認定符合條件，例如財力不足無法維持學業生活，或學校教學研究單位需要協助[3]。高中（含）以下學生不能申請[11]，大陸學生目前不得申請學生工作許可[10]。
steps.notes_en: Students formally admitted to a degree programme can apply as soon as they enrol; foreign students in language courses must have studied for at least six months[1][3]. The rules also require your school to confirm you meet the conditions, for example that you cannot cover your study and living costs, or that a teaching or research unit needs your help[3]. High school students cannot apply[11], and mainland Chinese students currently cannot get a student work permit[10].

steps.title_zh: 先填寫逢甲國際處的工讀問卷
steps.title_en: Fill out FCU OIA's work survey first
steps.notes: 逢甲國際處要求先完成當學年度的境外生工讀問卷，沒有填寫的申請不受理[9]。港澳生在線上系統的身分欄位要選「華僑學生」[9]。
steps.notes_en: FCU's Office of International Affairs requires you to complete this academic year's survey for international students who work first; applications without it are not accepted[9]. Hong Kong and Macao students should choose 'overseas Chinese student' as their status in the online system[9].

steps.notes: 到外國專業人員工作許可申辦網選「僑外生工讀申請」申請學生帳號，登入後填寫 L00「外國留學生、僑生及華裔學生工作許可申請書」，上傳 PDF 檔案後送件[1][2]。依勞動部規定，學生只需填申請表並附護照影本，不必再附學生證或學校同意書[7]；逢甲國際處則要求上傳學生證正反面（須有當學期註冊章，或改附在學證明）、護照資料頁及居留證正反面[9]。許可期間會跨到下一學年時，要附次學年第一學期的註冊證明[1]。
steps.notes_en: On the online application website for foreign professionals' work permits, choose the overseas and international student work application and register a student account. Log in, fill in form L00 (work permit application for foreign, overseas Chinese and ethnic Chinese students), upload it as a PDF and submit[1][2]. The Ministry of Labor only requires the form and a copy of your passport, not your student ID or a school consent letter[7]; FCU's Office of International Affairs, however, asks you to upload both sides of your student ID (stamped for this semester, or a certificate of enrollment instead), your passport's data page and both sides of your ARC[9]. If the permit period will run into the next academic year, attach proof of registration for the first semester of that year[1].

steps.notes: 外國人申請工作許可的審查費是每件新臺幣100元[4]。可用郵政劃撥繳費，再回系統登錄收據資料；也可以用 ATM 繳費，取得繳費序號後要儘快付款[2]。ATM 付款要等系統隔日中午對帳成功後才能送出；臺灣Pay 須在產生 QR code 後5分鐘內付款[12]。劃撥單可到國際處或郵局索取[9]。中途更換繳費方式可能造成重複繳費[12]。
steps.notes_en: The review fee for a foreigner's work permit is NT$100 per application[4]. You can pay by postal transfer and then enter the receipt details in the system, or pay at an ATM; after you get a payment number, pay soon[2]. An ATM payment can only be submitted after the system reconciles it at noon the next day; with Taiwan Pay you must pay within five minutes of generating the QR code[12]. Postal transfer slips are available at the Office of International Affairs or any post office[9]. Switching payment methods halfway can mean paying twice[12].

steps.title_en: Download the e-permit within 8 days of approval
steps.notes: 核准後系統會寄電子郵件通知，請在8日內登入申辦網下載並列印電子工作許可函；逾期沒領取，改寄紙本公文[8]。勞動部已不再核發實體工作證卡[11]。需要補件時，勞動部會用電子郵件通知[9]。
steps.notes_en: After approval you will get an email. Log in to the website within eight days to download and print your electronic work permit; if you don't, a paper letter is posted to you instead[8]. The Ministry of Labor no longer issues physical permit cards[11]. If documents are missing, the Ministry will tell you by email[9].

steps.title_en: Follow the hour limit and validity period
steps.notes: 除寒暑假外，每週最多工作20小時；寒暑假不受20小時限制，但仍須遵守勞動基準法工時規定[3][6]。許可期間最長1年：上學期申請的，原則上可用到次年9月30日；下學期申請的，原則上到當年9月30日；附上註冊證明可不受9月30日限制，但最長仍是1年[2][3]。畢業後學生工作許可隨即失效[9]。未取得許可就工作，可處新臺幣3萬元以上15萬元以下罰鍰，並會被令出國[5]。
steps.notes_en: Outside the winter and summer breaks you may work up to 20 hours a week; during the breaks the 20-hour limit does not apply, but the working hours rules of the Labor Standards Act still do[3][6]. A permit lasts at most one year: one applied for in the first semester normally runs until 30 September of the next year; one applied for in the second semester normally runs until 30 September of that year. With proof of registration it can go past 30 September, but never beyond one year[2][3]. The student work permit ends as soon as you graduate[9]. Working without a permit can bring a fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000 and an order to leave Taiwan[5].

cards.title_en: Getting a Certificate of Enrollment at FCU
cards.description_zh: 在學證明書可以證明你目前是逢甲大學的在學學生，常用在申請或延長居留證、申請工作許可等場合。由教務處註冊課務組受理，提供中文版和英文版，在校生每份工本費新臺幣10元。
cards.description_en: A Certificate of Enrollment shows that you are currently a registered FCU student. It is often needed for ARC applications and extensions and for work-permit paperwork. The Registration Section of the Office of Academic Affairs issues it in Chinese or English; current students pay NT$10 per copy.
cards.applicable_to: 逢甲大學在校生（含境外學位生）
cards.applicable_to_en: Current FCU students, including international degree students

cards.location_en: FCU Registration Section, Office of Academic Affairs (Room 123, Information & Electrical Engineering Building; +886-4-2451-7250 ext. 2111; registration@fcu.edu.tw)

steps.title_zh: 確認用途與中文版或英文版
steps.title_en: Decide what it is for and which language you need
steps.notes: 註冊課務組提供中文版和英文版的在學證明書[1]。境外生申請居留證時需要附在學證明[6]。辦學生工作許可時，學生證沒有當學期註冊章的，國際處接受改附在學證明[7]。
steps.notes_en: The Registration Section issues certificates of enrollment in Chinese and in English[1]. International students need one when they apply for an ARC[6]. For a student work permit, the Office of International Affairs accepts a certificate of enrollment instead of a student ID without this semester's registration stamp[7].

steps.notes: 註冊課務組負責學籍、成績等相關文件的申請業務[3]，地點在資訊電機館123室，電話 04-2451-7250 分機2111，Email：registration@fcu.edu.tw[2]。官方頁面沒有寫明在校生能否線上或用自助機申請，建議出發前先打電話或寫信確認。
steps.notes_en: The Registration Section handles requests for enrolment, grade and other student records[3]. It is in Room 123 of the Information and Electrical Engineering Building, tel. 04-2451-7250 ext. 2111, email registration@fcu.edu.tw[2]. The official pages don't say whether current students can apply online or at a self-service machine, so call or email before you go.

steps.notes: 在校生申請中文或英文在學證明書，每份新臺幣10元[1]。
steps.notes_en: Current students pay NT$10 per copy for a Chinese or English certificate of enrollment[1].

steps.title_en: Collect it and check the details
steps.notes: 拿到後請核對姓名、學號、系所和就讀期間，並依送件單位要求準備份數。華語中心學生如果需要「在學及出席證明」，要先填寫表格，並至少預留1個工作天製作，學生須主動事先聯絡華語中心[8]。
steps.notes_en: When you get it, check your name, student number, department and period of study, and prepare as many copies as the receiving office needs. Chinese Language Center students who need a certificate of enrollment and attendance must fill in a form, allow at least one working day, and contact the center in advance themselves[8].

cards.title_zh: 外籍學生在臺開立銀行／郵局帳戶
cards.title_en: Opening a Bank or Post Office Account as an International Student
cards.description_zh: 逢甲是無現金校園，工讀金、獎學金、助學金都要匯入學生本人的帳戶，所以入學後應盡早開戶。外籍學生通常要帶居留證和第二身分證件（例如護照），親自到銀行或郵局臨櫃辦理。每家機構的居留期限門檻、開戶金額和是否接受沒有居留證的人開戶都不同，去之前請先確認。
cards.description_en: FCU is a cashless campus: work-study pay, scholarships and grants go into an account in the student's own name, so open one soon after arrival. International students usually apply in person with their ARC plus a second photo ID such as a passport. Residence-period limits, opening deposits and whether people without an ARC are accepted differ between banks and the post office, so check before you go.
cards.applicable_to: 在逢甲就讀、年滿18歲的外籍學位生、交換生及華語生（最好已取得居留證）
cards.applicable_to_en: International degree, exchange and Chinese-language students at FCU aged 18 or over, ideally already holding an ARC
cards.location: 台新銀行逢甲分行（臺中市西屯區河南路二段201號，04-2451-7890）、其他銀行分行或郵局
cards.location_en: Taishin Bank Fengjia Branch (No. 201, Sec. 2, Henan Rd., Xitun Dist., Taichung; 04-2451-7890), other banks, or a post office

steps.notes: 持居留簽證入境者，須在入境翌日起30天內向移民署申請居留證[11]。持居留證的外國人，開戶時用居留證加另一種能辨識身分的證件[1][3]。沒有居留證的外籍學生，依法規也可以用合法入境的護照加「中華民國統一證號基資表」開戶[1][2][3]；但郵局自2025年6月13日起暫停受理這種方式，只有請領教育部華語文獎學金或外交部台歐連結獎學金、並附學校證明者例外[8]。
steps.notes_en: If you entered on a resident visa, apply to the NIA for your ARC within 30 days of the day after you arrive[11]. Foreigners with an ARC open an account with their ARC plus a second form of ID[1][3]. Under the rules, international students without an ARC can also open one with the passport they entered on plus an R.O.C. unified ID number record[1][2][3]; however, since 13 June 2025 the post office no longer accepts this, except for recipients of the Ministry of Education's Huayu Enrichment Scholarship or the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Taiwan-Europe Connectivity Scholarship who bring a school letter[8].

steps.notes: 準備居留證和第二身分證件（護照、健保卡或駕照等）[1][4][8]。台新銀行要求居留原因是就學的人另外提供學生證或相關證明[4]。年滿18歲者不必附法定代理人同意書[1]。國發會網站建議準備臺灣手機號碼，供聯絡與驗證使用[10]。郵局開戶要留存印鑑或本人簽名[8]。
steps.notes_en: Bring your ARC and a second ID (passport, NHI card, driver's licence, etc.)[1][4][8]. Taishin Bank asks people living here to study to also show a student ID or similar proof[4]. If you are 18 or over, you don't need consent from a legal guardian[1]. The National Development Council recommends having a Taiwanese mobile number for contact and verification[10]. The post office keeps a seal or your signature on file[8].

steps.title_en: Choose a bank or post office
steps.notes: 逢甲新生專區說明，沒有銀行帳戶的學生可以到台新銀行逢甲分行開戶[7]，分行電話04-2451-7890，分行代碼051[6]。學校登錄帳戶時也接受郵局及農漁會帳戶[7][13]。各銀行有自己的內規，例如台新銀行規定從申請日起算居留期限不足3個月的人不能開戶[4]。
steps.notes_en: FCU's new student pages say students without a bank account can open one at Taishin Bank's Fengjia branch[7], tel. 04-2451-7890, branch code 051[6]. When you register an account with the school, post office and farmers' or fishermen's association accounts are also accepted[7][13]. Each bank has its own rules; for example, Taishin won't open an account if less than three months remain on your residence permit from the day you apply[4].

steps.title_zh: 親自臨櫃辦理並存入開戶金額
steps.title_en: Apply in person and make the opening deposit
steps.notes: 郵局規定外籍人士必須本人親自辦理，要填寫立帳申請書、存款單和CRS自我證明表格，具美國身分者另填W-9[8]。銀行會查核雙重身分證明文件；居留證在期滿前已被註銷或屬逾期居留的，銀行應拒絕開戶[9]。最低開戶金額：台新新臺幣活期性存款1,000元[5]，郵局存簿儲金頁面列為10元[8]。
steps.notes_en: The post office requires foreigners to apply in person and fill in an account application, a deposit slip and a CRS self-certification; US persons also fill in a W-9[8]. Banks check two forms of ID and must refuse to open an account if the ARC has been cancelled before its expiry date or if you have overstayed[9]. Minimum opening deposits: NT$1,000 for a Taishin NT$ demand deposit account[5]; the post office's savings page lists NT$10[8].

steps.notes: 金管會已開放持晶片居留證的外國人線上開戶[12]。以台新Richart為例，自2025年6月16日起的條件是：年滿18歲、持有效居留證且核發日到有效日超過一年、申辦時距居留證到期不少於90天、尚無台新新臺幣存款帳戶[14]。
steps.notes_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission allows foreigners with a chip ARC to open accounts online[12]. For Taishin's Richart, the conditions since 16 June 2025 are: aged 18 or over, a valid ARC with more than one year between its issue and expiry dates, at least 90 days left before it expires when you apply, and no existing Taishin NT$ deposit account[14].

steps.notes: 拿到存摺後，到MyFCU「銀行帳號維護」填寫帳號並上傳存摺封面，供學校撥款使用（見「在MyFCU登錄撥款銀行帳戶」流程卡）[7]。居留證換發後，請盡快帶新證到銀行更新資料，否則可能被暫時限制交易[4]。
steps.notes_en: Once you have your passbook, enter the account number in MyFCU under Bank Account Maintenance and upload the passbook cover so the school can pay you (see the guide 'Registering Your Bank Account in MyFCU')[7]. When you get a new ARC, take it to the bank soon to update your details, or your account may be temporarily restricted[4].

cards.title_en: Registering Your Bank Account in MyFCU
cards.description_zh: 逢甲是無現金校園，工讀金、獎學金、助學金等款項都匯入學生在MyFCU「銀行帳號維護」登錄的本人帳戶。學生要填寫帳號並上傳存摺封面，由財務處出納組人工審核。郵局、農漁會和銀行帳戶都可以登錄。
cards.description_en: FCU is a cashless campus: work-study pay, scholarships and grants go into the account in your own name that you register under 'Bank Account Maintenance' in MyFCU. Enter the account number and upload the passbook cover; the Cashier Section checks it by hand. Post office, farmers'/fishermen's association and bank accounts are all accepted.
cards.applicable_to: 所有逢甲在學學生（含境外生），尤其是要領工讀金、獎助學金或生活助學金的人
cards.applicable_to_en: All FCU students, including international students, especially anyone receiving work-study pay, scholarships or grants
cards.location: 線上：MyFCU；承辦單位為財務處出納組
cards.location_en: Online in MyFCU; handled by the Cashier Section, Office of Financial Affairs

steps.title_en: Have an account in your own name
steps.notes: 帳戶必須是學生本人的郵局、農漁會或銀行帳戶[3]。沒有帳戶的人，新生專區建議申請網路銀行，或到台新銀行逢甲分行開戶[1]。
steps.notes_en: The account must be a post office, farmers' or fishermen's association, or bank account in your own name[3]. If you don't have one, the new student pages suggest applying for online banking or opening an account at Taishin Bank's Fengjia branch[1].

steps.title_zh: 登入MyFCU進入「銀行帳號維護」
steps.notes: 用學號或NID登入MyFCU[7]，路徑是「校園生活」→「帳務」→「銀行帳號維護」[2][4]；也可以在MyFCU搜尋欄輸入「銀行」直接進入[1]。
steps.notes_en: Log in to MyFCU with your student number or NID[7] and go to Campus Life → Accounts → Bank Account Maintenance[2][4]; you can also type 'bank' (銀行) in the MyFCU search box to get there[1].

steps.notes: 郵局存簿：選「郵局」，填14碼帳號。銀行存簿：從下拉選單選銀行和分行，依7碼金融代碼填寫（前3碼是銀行，後4碼是分行），再照存摺填帳號[1]。
steps.notes_en: Post office passbook: choose Post Office and enter the 14-digit account number. Bank passbook: choose the bank and branch from the list using the 7-digit financial code (the first 3 digits are the bank, the last 4 the branch), then enter the account number as shown in the passbook[1].

steps.notes: 上傳存摺封面圖檔，畫面上要看得到學生本人的戶名、分行和帳號[1][3][4]。
steps.notes_en: Upload an image of the passbook cover showing your own name, the branch and the account number[1][3][4].

steps.notes: 送出後由出納組人工審核[1]。在「銀行帳號維護」裡可以查詢已使用的帳號和申請歷程[2]。生活助學金等款項要先建立個人匯款帳戶才能撥款[5]。有問題可洽出納組（總機04-2451-7250）[3][6]。
steps.notes_en: After you submit, the Cashier's Section checks it by hand[1]. Under Bank Account Maintenance you can see the accounts you have used and your request history[2]. Living allowances and other payments can only be paid once your personal account is set up[5]. For questions, contact the Cashier's Section (switchboard 04-2451-7250)[3][6].

cards.title_en: Requesting Leave from Classes at FCU
cards.description_zh: 逢甲學生請假要用MyFCU的線上請假系統申請，並依請假原因上傳證明文件。事假和病假由任課教師核准，公假由學務長核准；公假必須事前請，事後不能補。因特殊事故沒辦法事先請假的人，要在3個工作日內補辦。
cards.description_en: FCU students request leave through the online leave system in MyFCU and upload proof for the reason. Personal and sick leave are approved by each course instructor; official leave is approved by the Dean of Student Affairs and must be arranged in advance. If an emergency prevented you from applying in advance, apply within 3 working days.
cards.applicable_to: 逢甲大學所有在學學生（含境外生）
cards.applicable_to_en: All FCU students, including international students
cards.location: 線上：MyFCU→九宮格選單→課程學習→請假系統；承辦單位為學務處（student@fcu.edu.tw）
cards.location_en: Online: MyFCU → menu → Course Learning → Leave System; Office of Student Affairs (student@fcu.edu.tw)

steps.notes: 學生請假辦法列有事假、病假、喪假、公假、生理假、原住民族歲時祭儀假等假別[2]。學務處學生請假頁面整理了假別、流程、證明和假單更正方式[1]。
steps.notes_en: The student leave rules list personal leave, sick leave, bereavement leave, official leave, menstrual leave, indigenous ceremonial leave and others[2]. The Office of Student Affairs' leave page explains the leave types, the process, the proof needed and how to correct a leave request[1].

steps.title_en: Log in to the leave system
steps.notes: 用個人NID帳號登入MyFCU，點左上角九宮格選單→「課程學習」→「請假系統」[1]。
steps.notes_en: Log in to MyFCU with your NID, open the grid menu at the top left → Course Learning → Leave System[1].

steps.title_en: Fill in the form and upload proof
steps.notes: 請假要經請假系統完成，並依請假原因上傳證明文件[1][2]。病假2日以內可用醫療院所的診療單，超過2日要診斷證明書；事假要家長或監護人證明或其他證明；喪假可附訃文或死亡證明；生理假不需要證明[2]。
steps.notes_en: Request leave in the leave system and upload proof for your reason[1][2]. For sick leave of up to 2 days a clinic or hospital receipt is enough; for more than 2 days you need a medical certificate. Personal leave needs proof from a parent or guardian or other proof; bereavement leave can use an obituary or death certificate; menstrual leave needs no proof[2].

steps.notes: 原則上事前申請。因特殊事故沒辦法事先請假的人，要在3個工作日內說明理由並附證明補辦。公假和原住民族歲時祭儀假必須事前完成手續，事後不能補請[2]。沒辦法登入系統的人可請生活導師協助，但要在請假日起一個月內辦理[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: Leave should normally be requested in advance. If an emergency stops you, explain why and attach proof within 3 working days. Official leave and indigenous ceremonial leave must be arranged beforehand and cannot be requested afterwards[2]. If you cannot log in to the system, your homeroom teacher can help, but it must be done within one month of the leave[1][2].

steps.notes: 事假和病假由各科任課教師核准，公假由學務長核准[2]；教師在系統中批核假單[5]。未請假或請假未經核准就不上課，以曠課論[2]。因學校活動請公假的，由承辦的教職員在系統中提出[4]。
steps.notes_en: Personal and sick leave are approved by each course's teacher, and official leave by the Dean of Student Affairs[2]; teachers approve requests in the system[5]. Missing class without leave, or without approved leave, counts as an unexcused absence[2]. For official leave for school activities, the staff member in charge files it in the system[4].

cards.title_en: Replacing a Lost FCU Student ID (FCU Card)
cards.description_zh: 逢甲學生證（逢甲卡）遺失、被竊、被搶、被騙取或被他人占有時，可以在MyFCU的「成績及學籍文件申請」選「補發學生證」線上申請。在校生補發的工本費是新臺幣250元。逢甲卡同時是悠遊卡，遺失後應盡快處理。
cards.description_en: If your FCU Card is lost, stolen or held by someone else, apply online in MyFCU under the transcript and student record document service, choosing 'Student ID Reissue'. The fee for enrolled students is NT$250. The card also works as an EasyCard, so act quickly.
cards.applicable_to: 逢甲大學在校生（含境外生）
cards.applicable_to_en: Enrolled FCU students, including international students
cards.location: 線上：MyFCU；承辦單位為教務處註冊課務組（04-2451-7250分機2111，registration@fcu.edu.tw）
cards.location_en: Online via MyFCU; Registration Section, Office of Academic Affairs (04-2451-7250 ext. 2111, registration@fcu.edu.tw)

steps.title_en: Act quickly on the lost card
steps.notes: 逢甲卡兼具悠遊卡功能。遺失、被竊、被搶、被騙取或被他人占有時，都可以申請補發，應盡快辦理[1]。
steps.notes_en: The FCU Card also works as an EasyCard. If it is lost, stolen, robbed, taken by fraud or held by someone else, you can get it replaced; do it as soon as you can[1].

steps.notes: 登入MyFCU，進入「成績及學籍文件申請」服務，選「補發學生證」[1]。
steps.notes_en: Log in to MyFCU, open the service for grade and enrolment document requests, and choose student ID replacement[1].

steps.notes: 註冊課務組收費標準：在校生申請補發學生證，工本費250元[2]。申請時請以系統顯示的金額為準。
steps.notes_en: The Registration Section's fee for current students replacing a student ID is NT$250[2]. Go by the amount the system shows when you apply.

steps.title_zh: 向註冊課務組確認領取
steps.title_en: Confirm pickup with the Registration Section
steps.notes: 領取時間和方式請洽註冊課務組：電話04-2451-7250分機2111，信箱registration@fcu.edu.tw，週一至週五9:00–17:00[3]。
steps.notes_en: Ask the Registration Section when and how to collect it: tel. 04-2451-7250 ext. 2111, email registration@fcu.edu.tw, Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00[3].

cards.title_zh: 境外新生報到（國際事務處）
cards.title_en: Overseas Newcomer Registration at the Office of International Affairs
cards.description_zh: 逢甲大學境外新生抵臺後，須依國際事務處公告的日期與時段，帶齊正本文件到場報到。報到前要先在 MyFCU 完成新生報到檢核等應辦事項。報到後須參加學校的新生成長營。
cards.description_en: After arriving in Taiwan, FCU's new overseas students register in person with the Office of International Affairs (OIA), bringing original documents on the announced date and time slot. Finish the MyFCU checklist and other tasks first. New students then attend the Freshman Growth Camp.
cards.applicable_to: 逢甲大學學位班境外新生（外國學生、僑生、港澳生），含秋季班與春季班入學者。交換生另有規定，不適用本卡。
cards.applicable_to_en: New overseas degree students at FCU (international, overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao students), fall or spring intake. Exchange students follow separate rules.
cards.location: 逢甲大學國際事務處，行政二館303室（秋季班第一梯次可能改在行政二館4樓411教室，以當期公告為準）
cards.location_en: FCU Office of International Affairs, Room 303, Administration Building II (fall first session may be in Room 411, 4F; check each intake's notice)

steps.notes: 報到前請先完成 MyFCU 新生報到檢核表上的項目，包括上傳學生證照片、用 NID 帳號填寫當期「逢甲大學境外學生基本資料表」，並在期限內繳清學雜費[1][2]。完整步驟見新生專區的境外新生頁面[3]。
steps.notes_en: Before registration day, complete the items on the MyFCU new student checklist: upload your student ID photo, fill in this term's FCU international student information form with your NID, and pay tuition by the deadline[1][2]. The full steps are on the international freshman page of the new student site[3].

steps.notes: 入學錄取通知書正本；畢業證書正本（須經我國駐外館處或僑委會驗證）；成績單正本（須驗證）；護照正本並附中華民國居留簽證；已有居留證者帶正本；2吋（3.5×4.5cm）白底彩色證件照 jpg 電子檔[1][2]。僑生另附海外聯招會分發證明；港澳生帶入出境許可證及港澳身分證[2]。
steps.notes_en: Bring the original of your admission letter; your diploma (authenticated by a Taiwan overseas mission or the Overseas Community Affairs Council); your transcript (authenticated); your passport with your R.O.C. resident visa; your ARC if you already have one; and a 2-inch (3.5×4.5cm) colour ID photo with a white background as a jpg file[1][2]. Overseas compatriot students also bring their placement notice from the overseas joint admission committee; Hong Kong and Macao students bring their entry and exit permit and Hong Kong or Macao ID card[2].

steps.title_zh: 港澳生滿20歲附警察紀錄證明
steps.title_en: HK/Macao students aged 20+: bring a police record
steps.notes: 港澳生已滿20歲者，註冊時請攜帶香港或澳門警察紀錄證明書[1][2]，須為3個月內開立，未滿20歲者免附[4]。
steps.notes_en: Hong Kong and Macao students aged 20 or over should bring a Hong Kong or Macao police clearance certificate when they register[1][2]. It must have been issued within the last three months; students under 20 don't need one[4].

steps.title_en: Register at your assigned time slot
steps.notes: 2026春季班報到時間是 2026/2/23 10:00，地點為行政二館303室[2]。秋季班第一梯次依國別分時段，地點為行政二館4樓411教室；無法參加者改第二梯次，地點為303室[1]。每學期日期不同，請以當期公告為準。
steps.notes_en: Registration for spring 2026 is on 23 February 2026 at 10:00 in Room 303, Administration Building II[2]. For the fall term, the first round is in time slots by country, in Room 411 on the 4th floor of Administration Building II; if you can't make it, join the second round in Room 303[1]. Dates change every term, so follow the current notice.

steps.notes: LINE 顯示名稱請改為「學號＋姓名」。外國學生與僑生加入國際學生群組，港澳生加入港澳生群組[2]。國際處電話 04-24517250，外國學生及僑生分機2498，港澳生分機2493[2]。
steps.notes_en: Change your LINE display name to your student number plus your name. Foreign and overseas compatriot students join the international student group; Hong Kong and Macao students join the Hong Kong and Macao group[2]. The Office of International Affairs: tel. 04-24517250, ext. 2498 for foreign and overseas compatriot students, ext. 2493 for Hong Kong and Macao students[2].

steps.notes: 115學年度所有新生都必須參加2026新生成長營；無法出席者請在 MyFCU 請假[6]。2026年新生成長營於9月1日至3日舉行[5]。
steps.notes_en: All new students in the 2026–27 academic year must attend the 2026 Freshman Growth Camp; if you can't attend, request leave in MyFCU[6]. The 2026 camp runs from 1 to 3 September[5].

cards.description_zh: 逢甲新生要在 MyFCU 的「報到流程檢核」逐項完成報到應辦事項。綠色代表已完成，紅色代表未完成。請在期限前讓所有項目轉為綠燈，並提早上傳學生證照片，才能在報到當天領取學生證。
cards.description_en: FCU freshmen complete registration tasks in MyFCU's Check List of Registration. Green means done, red means not yet done. Turn every item green before the deadline, and upload your ID photo early to collect your student card on registration day.

steps.title_zh: 以 NID 登入 MyFCU 開啟檢核表
steps.title_en: Log in to MyFCU and open the checklist
steps.notes: 用 NID 帳號登入 MyFCU，依序點選「新生資訊 → 新生必做 → 報到流程檢核」；英文介面是 For New Student → Things to Do → Check List of Registration[1][2]。NID 帳號格式為「學號@o365.fcu.edu.tw」[4]。
steps.notes_en: Log in to MyFCU with your NID and go to 新生資訊 → 新生必做 → 報到流程檢核; in the English interface it is For New Student → Things to Do → Check List of Registration[1][2]. Your NID is your student number followed by @o365.fcu.edu.tw[4].

steps.title_zh: 依燈號確認未完成項目
steps.notes: 已完成的項目顯示綠色，未完成的顯示紅色，目標是把所有紅燈變成綠燈[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: Finished items show green and unfinished ones show red; the goal is to turn every red light green[1][2].

steps.notes: 上傳到 MyFCU 學生綜合資料卡，規格為2吋（3.5×4.5cm）正面、脫帽、白底彩色證件照，jpg 格式，請依學校示意裁剪[2][3][4]。在期限前上傳，報到當天才能領到學生證[1]。
steps.notes_en: Upload your photo to the MyFCU student profile: a 2-inch (3.5×4.5cm), front-facing, bare-headed colour ID photo with a white background, as a jpg, cropped as the school's example shows[2][3][4]. Upload it before the deadline so you can collect your student ID on registration day[1].

steps.title_zh: 填寫新生健康問題評估表
steps.notes: 在報到流程檢核中填寫「新生健康問題評估表」，再選擇參加校內健檢、到校外指定醫院，或自行到鄰近醫院檢查；自行檢查必須使用學校表格[5]。
steps.notes_en: In the registration checklist, fill in the freshman health questionnaire, then choose to take the on-campus health check, go to a designated hospital off campus, or get checked at a nearby hospital yourself; if you go on your own, you must use the school's form[5].

steps.title_zh: 繳學雜費並等待燈號更新
steps.title_en: Pay tuition and wait for the light to update
steps.notes: 請在期限內繳清學雜費[4]。現金匯款者須把匯款證明 email 給財務處[6]。在超商繳費者，銷帳需要時間，燈號會延遲更新[2][6]。所有項目都要在期限內完成，有問題請聯絡各項目的負責單位[1]。
steps.notes_en: Pay tuition by the deadline[4]. If you pay by bank transfer, email the transfer receipt to the Office of Finance[6]. If you pay at a convenience store, it takes time to clear, so the light updates later[2][6]. Finish every item by its deadline, and contact the office responsible for an item if you have questions[1].

cards.title_zh: 停留簽證改辦就學居留簽證
cards.title_en: Changing a Study Visitor Visa to a Resident Visa
cards.description_zh: 持「就學」目的停留簽證入境、要在臺灣長期就學的外國學生，要在停留期限屆滿前取得居留身分。可以向領事事務局或中部辦事處申請改辦居留簽證（審核8個工作天），領事事務局也說明可在停留期限屆滿前直接向移民署申請居留。拿到居留簽證後，30日內申請外僑居留證。
cards.description_en: If you entered on a study-purpose visitor visa and will study long term, get resident status before your permitted stay ends. You can change to a resident visa at BOCA or its Central Taiwan Office (8 working days), and BOCA also says you may apply for residence directly at the NIA before your stay expires. Apply for an ARC within 30 days of getting the resident visa.
cards.applicable_to: 持「就學」目的停留簽證入境、要繼續在臺就學的外國學生。用免簽證、落地簽證、電子簽證入境，或持非就學目的停留簽證的人，不能以就學為由改辦。
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign students who entered on a study-purpose visitor visa and will keep studying. Not for visa-exempt, landing-visa or eVisa entrants, or non-study visitor visas.
cards.location: 外交部中部辦事處（臺中市南屯區黎明路2段503號1樓，04-2251-0799），或移民署學生線上申辦系統
cards.location_en: MOFA Central Taiwan Office (1F, No. 503, Sec. 2, Liming Rd., Nantun Dist., Taichung; 04-2251-0799), or the NIA online system

steps.title_zh: 確認你的簽證能不能改辦
steps.notes: 只有持「就學」目的停留簽證的人可以辦；用免簽證、落地簽證、電子簽證入境，或簽證不是就學目的的人，都不能以就學為由轉換居留簽證或延長停留[1]。持就學事由停留簽證入境的正式班學生，也可以在停留期限屆滿前直接向移民署申請居留[1]，送件前請向國際處確認要走哪個管道。
steps.notes_en: Only people holding a visitor visa issued for study can do this. If you entered visa-free, on a landing visa, an eVisa, or on a visa for another purpose, you cannot change to a resident visa or extend your stay for study[1]. Degree students who entered on a visitor visa for study can also apply directly to the NIA for residence before their permitted stay ends[1], so check with the Office of International Affairs which route to take before you apply.

steps.notes: 護照（效期6個月以上）與資料頁影本、線上填寫並列印的申請表、6個月內2吋彩色照片2張[2]；入學許可、最高學歷證件與成績單（非中英文附譯本並經驗證）；3個月內由衛福部指定醫院開立的健康檢查合格證明[1][2]；6個月經常性財力證明[1]。在國內改辦另附在學證明、註冊證明、在校成績單[1]，以及停留簽證和入境章影本[2]。
steps.notes_en: Your passport (valid for at least 6 months) and a copy of its data page, the application form filled in online and printed, and two 2-inch colour photos taken within 6 months[2]; your admission letter, your highest diploma and transcript (with an authenticated translation if not in Chinese or English); a passing health certificate from a hospital designated by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, issued within 3 months[1][2]; and proof of regular finances for the last 6 months[1]. When applying in Taiwan, also attach a certificate of enrollment, proof of registration and your school transcript[1], plus copies of your visitor visa and entry stamp[2].

steps.title_zh: 停留期滿前8個工作天送件
steps.title_en: Apply 8 working days before your stay ends
steps.notes: 在國內審核需要8個工作天，所以要在停留期限屆滿的8個工作天前送件[2]。臺中可到外交部中部辦事處：臺中市南屯區黎明路2段503號1樓，週一至週五08:30–17:00，電話04-2251-0799[4]。接到補件通知要在7日內補齊，否則退件且規費不退[2]。
steps.notes_en: Review in Taiwan takes 8 working days, so apply at least 8 working days before your permitted stay ends[2]. In Taichung, go to the Bureau of Consular Affairs' Central Taiwan Office: 1F, No. 503, Sec. 2, Liming Rd., Nantun Dist., Taichung, Mon–Fri 08:30–17:00, tel. 04-2251-0799[4]. If you are asked for more documents, provide them within 7 days, or the application is returned and the fee is not refunded[2].

steps.notes: 國內申請單次入境居留簽證新臺幣2,200元；入境後申請改發，每件另收特別手續費新臺幣800元[3]。依對等原則，部分國籍（例如美國）費用不同[3]。簽證被拒發時規費不退[2]。
steps.notes_en: A single-entry resident visa applied for in Taiwan costs NT$2,200; changing your visa after entry adds a special handling fee of NT$800 per application[3]. Under reciprocity, fees differ for some nationalities (for example, the United States)[3]. The fee is not refunded if the visa is refused[2].

steps.title_en: Apply for your ARC within 30 days
steps.notes: 在國內改發居留簽證的人，要在簽發日起30日內向移民署申請外僑居留證[1]，外國學生透過移民署學生線上申辦系統送件[5]（見「首次申請外僑居留證」流程卡）。逢甲國際處也提醒要在30日內申請[6]。
steps.notes_en: If you changed to a resident visa in Taiwan, apply to the NIA for your ARC within 30 days of its issue date[1]. Foreign students apply through the NIA's online system for students[5] (see the guide 'First ARC Application'). FCU's Office of International Affairs also reminds you to apply within 30 days[6].

cards.title_zh: 華語生申請居留（外僑居留證）
cards.description_zh: 自2024年1月1日起，持「研習中文」停留簽證的華語生，在同一所學校連續就讀滿4個月並繼續註冊3個月以上，可在停留期限屆滿前直接向移民署申請居留，不必先到領務局改辦居留簽證。每週至少上課15小時，缺課（含請假）不能超過總時數的四分之一。
cards.description_en: Since 1 January 2024, Mandarin students on a visitor visa for studying Chinese can apply for residence directly at the NIA before their stay expires, after 4 consecutive months at the same school with 3+ more months registered. They need at least 15 class hours a week, and absences (including leave) must not exceed a quarter of total hours.
cards.applicable_to: 持「研習中文」停留簽證、在教育部認可的大專校院華語中心（例如逢甲華語教學中心）連續就讀滿4個月並繼續註冊3個月以上的外籍學生
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign students on a visitor visa for studying Chinese, after 4 consecutive months at an MOE-recognized university language center (e.g. FCU CLC) with 3+ more months registered
cards.location: 移民署學生線上申辦系統；臺中市第一服務站（南屯區文心南三路22號1樓）
cards.location_en: NIA online student system; NIA Taichung City 1st Service Center (No. 22, Wenxin S. 3rd Rd., Nantun Dist.)

steps.notes: 自113年1月1日起，持「研習中文」停留簽證、在同一所學校連續就讀滿4個月並繼續註冊3個月以上的人，可在停留期限屆滿前直接向移民署申請居留[1]。上課時間在週一至週五，每週至少15小時[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: Since 1 January 2024, people on a visitor visa for Chinese study who have studied at the same school for 4 months in a row and registered for at least 3 more months can apply to the NIA for residence before their permitted stay ends[1]. Classes must be Monday to Friday, at least 15 hours a week[1][2].

steps.title_zh: 滿4個月前先準時延長停留
steps.title_en: Extend your visitor stay on time while you wait
steps.notes: 逢甲華語中心說明：停留簽證要在到期前10天內申請延期，並向中心申請在學及出席證明；經常缺課拿不到延期文件，遲到超過15分鐘算缺席[3]。
steps.notes_en: FCU's Chinese Language Center explains: apply to extend your visitor visa within 10 days before it expires, and ask the center for a certificate of enrollment and attendance. Students who miss class often won't get the extension documents, and arriving more than 15 minutes late counts as absent[3].

steps.title_zh: 向華語中心申請證明文件
steps.title_en: Get certificates from the language center
steps.notes: 在學證明與註冊證明（寫明已就讀滿4個月、繼續註冊3個月以上、每週至少15小時）[1][2]；出席紀錄證明正本及影本，缺課含請假不能超過總時數四分之一[1][2]；成績單。請提早向華語中心辦公室申請[3]。
steps.notes_en: You need a certificate of enrollment and proof of registration (stating 4 months completed, at least 3 more months registered, and at least 15 hours a week)[1][2]; your original attendance record and a copy, with absences, including leave, no more than a quarter of total hours[1][2]; and your transcript. Ask the Chinese Language Center office for these early[3].

steps.title_zh: 備齊其他文件並線上送件
steps.title_en: Gather other documents and apply online
steps.notes: 透過移民署學生線上申辦系統申請，準備護照、近2年內2吋照片、研習中文停留簽證、在臺居留住址證明；持停留簽證者另附3個月內健康檢查合格證明[2]。外僑居留證規費每年新臺幣1,000元，持停留簽證入國申請加收2,200元[2]。
steps.notes_en: Apply through the NIA's online system for students with your passport, a 2-inch photo taken within 2 years, your visitor visa for Chinese study and proof of your address in Taiwan; people on a visitor visa also attach a health certificate issued within 3 months[2]. The ARC fee is NT$1,000 a year, plus NT$2,200 if you entered on a visitor visa[2].

steps.title_zh: 延期時繼續符合上課規定
steps.title_en: Keep meeting class rules when you extend
steps.notes: 延期時要附外僑居留證和1個月內的在學證明[2]，並繼續符合每週15小時、缺課不超過四分之一的規定[1][2]。臺中市第一服務站週一至週五08:00–17:00[4]。
steps.notes_en: When you extend, attach your ARC and a certificate of enrollment issued within 1 month[2], and keep meeting the rules of 15 hours a week and absences of no more than a quarter[1][2]. The Taichung City First Service Station is open Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00[4].

cards.title_zh: 外僑居留證異動登記（住址變更等）
cards.title_en: ARC Change Registration (Address and Other Changes)
cards.description_zh: 持外僑居留證的外國學生，搬家或護照換新時要向移民署辦理異動登記。住址變更要從事實發生翌日起算30日內辦理，沒有辦理的話處新臺幣2,000元到10,000元罰鍰。可以透過移民署學生線上申辦系統申請。
cards.description_en: ARC holders must register changes such as a new address or a renewed passport with the NIA. Report an address change within 30 days counted from the day after the change, or face a fine of NT$2,000–10,000. You can apply through the NIA online student system.
cards.applicable_to: 持外僑居留證的外國學生（含華語生），居留住址、護照或其他居留資料有異動者
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign students (incl. Mandarin students) holding an ARC whose address, passport or other residence data has changed
cards.location: 移民署學生線上申辦系統，或遷入地的移民署服務站（臺中市第一服務站）
cards.location_en: NIA online student system, or the NIA service center for your new area (Taichung 1st Service Center)

steps.notes: 居留住址變更，要從事實發生翌日起算30日內辦理變更登記；未依規定辦理，處新臺幣2,000元以上10,000元以下罰鍰[1][2]。逢甲國際處也提醒要在30日內辦理[3]。
steps.notes_en: If your address changes, register the change within 30 days, counted from the day after it happens; not doing so can bring a fine of NT$2,000 to NT$10,000[1][2]. FCU's Office of International Affairs also reminds you to do it within 30 days[3].

steps.notes: 準備外僑居留證和異動證明文件，例如居留住址證明、更新後的護照[1]。住址證明可用租賃契約或其他能證明實際住址的文件；借住者附屋主同意說明書，加上房屋所有權狀影本或國人屋主身分證正反面影本[1]。
steps.notes_en: Prepare your ARC and proof of the change, such as proof of your address or your renewed passport[1]. For proof of address you can use your lease or another document showing where you actually live; if you stay with someone, attach the owner's letter of consent plus a copy of the property deed or of both sides of the Taiwanese owner's ID card[1].

steps.notes: 可用移民署學生線上申辦系統申請，上傳彩色電子檔（每檔512KB以內，jpg、png、pdf等）[1]；也可帶護照、外僑居留證和證明文件正本到遷入地的服務站辦理[2]。臺中市第一服務站週一至週五08:00–17:00[4]。
steps.notes_en: You can apply on the NIA's online system for students, uploading colour files (each up to 512KB, as jpg, png, pdf, etc.)[1], or take your passport, ARC and original documents to the service station for your new area[2]. The Taichung City First Service Station is open Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00[4].

steps.notes: 居留證補發，或因個人因素變更中英文姓名、出生日期、性別、照片等，每件新臺幣500元並重新製證[1]。
steps.notes_en: Replacing your ARC, or changing your Chinese or English name, date of birth, sex or photo for personal reasons, costs NT$500 and a new card is made[1].

cards.title_zh: 加入健保前的學生醫療保險（醫保／僑保）
cards.title_en: Student Medical Insurance Before NHI Eligibility
cards.description_zh: 依《外國學生來臺就學辦法》第22條，外國新生註冊時須附自入境當日起至少6個月效期的醫療及傷害保險。逢甲的外國學生在符合健保資格前，須加入學校的國際學生醫療保險（醫保）；僑生與港澳生第一學期可加入僑委會補助一半保費的僑保。
cards.description_en: Under Article 22 of the Regulations Regarding International Students Undertaking Studies in Taiwan, new foreign students need medical and injury insurance valid for at least six months from entry. At FCU, international students join the university's International Student Medical Insurance until NHI; overseas Chinese and HK/Macao students may join OCAC-subsidized insurance in their first semester.
cards.applicable_to: 尚未符合全民健保資格（在臺居留未滿6個月）的逢甲境外新生。醫保適用外國學生及陸生；僑保適用僑生及港澳生。
cards.applicable_to_en: New FCU overseas students not yet eligible for NHI (under 6 months' residence). FCU insurance for international and Mainland Chinese students; OCAC insurance for overseas Chinese and HK/Macao students.
cards.location: 逢甲大學國際事務處，行政二館303室（理賠申請書領取與送件）
cards.location_en: FCU Office of International Affairs, Room 303, Administration Building II (claim forms and submission)

steps.title_zh: 確認自己適用哪一種保險
steps.title_en: Check which insurance applies to you
steps.notes: 外國新生註冊時須附自入境當日起至少6個月效期的醫療及傷害保險；國外核發的證明須經駐外機構驗證[1]。逢甲的外國學生及陸生在符合健保資格前加入國際學生醫療保險（醫保）[2][3]。僑生及港澳生第一學期可加入僑保，期間6個月；期滿仍不符合健保資格者改加入醫保[2][4]。
steps.notes_en: International freshmen must show medical and accident insurance valid for at least 6 months from the day they enter Taiwan when they register; insurance issued abroad must be authenticated by a Taiwan overseas mission[1]. At FCU, foreign and mainland students join the international student medical insurance until they qualify for NHI[2][3]. Overseas compatriot and Hong Kong and Macao students can join the overseas compatriot student insurance for their first semester, for 6 months; if they still don't qualify for NHI after that, they switch to the international student insurance[2][4].

steps.notes: 醫保：NT$3,000/學期（NT$500/月），入學後不退費[2][3]。僑保：保費 NT$1,200，僑委會補助50%，學生自付 NT$600/學期[2][3][4]。國際處提醒醫保保障有限，建議另在本國購買留學生保險[2]。
steps.notes_en: International student insurance: NT$3,000 per semester (NT$500 a month), not refundable after you enrol[2][3]. Overseas compatriot student insurance: the premium is NT$1,200, half paid by the Overseas Community Affairs Council, so you pay NT$600 per semester[2][3][4]. The Office of International Affairs reminds you that the coverage is limited and recommends also buying student insurance in your home country[2].

steps.title_zh: 就醫並保留收據與診斷證明
steps.title_en: See a doctor and keep the receipt and diagnosis
steps.notes: 請到有健保特約的診所或醫院就診，保留收據正本與診斷證明書正本[2]。醫保理賠上限：門診或急診每日 NT$1,000；住院醫療每次 NT$120,000[2][3]。
steps.notes_en: See a doctor at a clinic or hospital that works with NHI, and keep the original receipt and the original medical certificate[2]. The international student insurance pays up to NT$1,000 a day for outpatient or emergency visits and up to NT$120,000 per hospital stay[2][3].

steps.title_zh: 備齊文件到國際處申請理賠
steps.notes: 把理賠申請書（向國際處領取）、收據正本、診斷證明正本、本人存摺封面影本、居留證或入台證影本送到國際事務處（行政二館303室），由學校統一向保險公司申請理賠[2][3]。
steps.notes_en: Take the claim form (from the Office of International Affairs), the original receipt, the original medical certificate, a copy of your passbook cover and a copy of your ARC or entry permit to the Office of International Affairs (Room 303, Administration Building II); the school files the claim with the insurer for you[2][3].

steps.title_zh: 居留滿6個月改加入全民健保
steps.notes: 僑外生在臺居留滿6個月起應參加全民健保；「滿6個月」指連續居住，或期間只出境1次且未超過30日，扣除出境日數後合計滿6個月[5]。（見「加入全民健康保險」流程卡）
steps.notes_en: International students must join NHI once they have lived in Taiwan for 6 months. "6 months" means living here continuously, or leaving only once for no more than 30 days, with the days away subtracted[5]. (See the guide 'Joining National Health Insurance'.)

cards.title_zh: 畢業後延期居留在臺覓職
cards.title_en: Staying in Taiwan After Graduation to Look for Work
cards.description_zh: 在臺灣取得副學士以上學位的外國學生，畢業後可在居留期限屆滿前申請延期居留，每次1年，有必要時可再申請1次，最長2年。自2026年1月1日起，這段延期居留期間在臺工作不必另外申請工作許可。學校會通報畢業，請及早辦理，以免原居留證被廢止。
cards.description_en: Foreign students with an associate degree or higher from Taiwan can extend residence for 1 year before it expires, plus one more extension if needed, up to 2 years. Since 1 January 2026 they can work during this extension without a separate work permit. Your school reports your graduation, so apply early to keep your ARC from being revoked.
cards.applicable_to: 在臺取得副學士以上學位、畢業後想留臺找工作的外國學位生（港澳生另有規定）
cards.applicable_to_en: Foreign degree students with an associate degree or higher from Taiwan who want to stay to look for work (Hong Kong and Macao students follow different rules)
cards.location: 移民署臺中市第一服務站（南屯區文心南三路22號1樓）；健保：居住地的區公所
cards.location_en: NIA Taichung 1st Service Center (No. 22, Wenxin S. 3rd Rd., Nantun Dist.); NHI: your district office

steps.title_zh: 在居留期限屆滿前申請延期
steps.notes: 在臺畢業的外國人可在居留期限屆滿前申請延期居留；核准後從原期限屆滿翌日起延長1年，有必要可再申請1次，最長2年[1][2][3]。學校會通報畢業，沒有及時辦理，原居留證可能被廢止[4]；逢甲國際處建議領到畢業證書後盡快辦理[4]。
steps.notes_en: Foreigners who graduate in Taiwan can apply to extend their residence before it expires; if approved, it is extended by 1 year from the day after the original expiry date, and you can apply once more if needed, up to 2 years in total[1][2][3]. The school reports your graduation, so if you don't apply in time your original ARC may be revoked[4]; FCU's Office of International Affairs suggests applying soon after you receive your diploma[4].

steps.notes: 準備畢業證書、護照和外僑居留證[1][4]。居留快到期但畢業證書還沒發下來時，可請學校開立書面證明並寫明頒發日期[1]。逢甲說明要親自到移民署服務站辦理[4]。
steps.notes_en: Prepare your diploma, passport and ARC[1][4]. If your residence is about to expire but your diploma hasn't been issued yet, ask the school for a letter stating the date it will be awarded[1]. FCU says you must apply in person at an NIA service station[4].

steps.title_en: You may work during the extension
steps.notes: 自2026年1月1日起，取得我國副學士以上學位的應屆畢業生，在移民署許可的延期居留期間工作免申請工作許可，工作類別不限，最長2年[2][3]。在學時的工作許可畢業後立即失效[4]。
steps.notes_en: Since 1 January 2026, new graduates with an associate degree or higher from Taiwan don't need a work permit to work during a residence extension approved by the NIA, in any type of job, for up to 2 years[2][3]. Your student work permit ends as soon as you graduate[4].

steps.title_zh: 不延期就繳回居留證並離境
steps.title_en: If not extending, return your ARC and leave
steps.notes: 畢業後不延期的人，要到服務站繳回外僑居留證並辦理離境手續[5]。
steps.notes_en: If you don't extend after graduating, return your ARC at a service station and complete the departure procedures[5].

steps.notes: 在學期間由學校投保[7]，學校通常只投保到畢業當月[4]。畢業後覓職期間符合資格的人，到居留地的區公所以第6類身分投保[6]；找到工作後改由雇主加保，並在學校辦理轉出[6][7]。逢甲提醒先向移民署辦好延期，再辦健保手續[4]。
steps.notes_en: While you study, the school insures you[7], usually only until the month you graduate[4]. While you look for work after graduating, if you qualify, enrol in NHI as Category 6 at the district office where you live[6]; once you find a job, your employer enrols you and you transfer out at the school[6][7]. FCU reminds you to extend your residence with the NIA first, then sort out NHI[4].

cards.title_zh: 外籍學生在逢甲的住宿：申請校內宿舍與校外租屋
cards.title_en: Housing at FCU for International Students: On-campus Dorms and Renting Off Campus
cards.description_zh: 逢甲的境外學位新生可以申請校內福星宿舍（男生 I 棟、女生 H 棟，四人雅房），床位要在開學前上 MyFCU 登錄並先繳一學期住宿費和保證金。交換生和博士生不能住校內宿舍，要自己在校外租屋；學務處有整理學校附近的合格租屋資訊。
cards.description_en: International degree freshmen at FCU can apply for a bed in the on-campus Fusing dorms (men in Building I, women in Building H, four-person rooms). Apply on MyFCU before term starts and pay one semester's fee plus a deposit up front. Exchange and PhD students cannot live in the on-campus dorms and rent off campus; the Office of Student Affairs lists vetted rentals near campus.
cards.applicable_to: 逢甲境外學位新生：秋季班大學部新生、春季班大學部與碩士班新生可申請校內宿舍；交換生、博士生需校外租屋
cards.applicable_to_en: International degree freshmen at FCU: fall bachelor's freshmen and spring bachelor's and master's freshmen may apply for on-campus dorms; exchange and PhD students rent off campus
cards.location: MyFCU 線上申請；福星宿舍：臺中市西屯區福星北路98號（走路到學校約15分鐘）
cards.location_en: Apply on MyFCU; Fusing dorms: No. 98, Fuxing N. Rd., Xitun Dist., Taichung (about 15 minutes' walk to campus)

steps.title_zh: 確認能不能住校內宿舍
steps.title_en: Check whether you can live on campus
steps.notes: 秋季班入學的境外大學部新生，安排住校內福星男、女宿舍四人雅房[1][2]。春季班入學的大學部與碩士班新生也可申請福星宿舍，床位有限[3]。交換生無法申請校內宿舍[4]；博士生請參考學務處的租屋資訊[3]。
steps.notes_en: Fall international bachelor's freshmen are placed in four-person rooms in the on-campus Fusing men's and women's dorms[1][2]. Spring bachelor's and master's freshmen can also apply for the Fusing dorms; beds are limited[3]. Exchange students cannot apply for on-campus dorms[4]; PhD students should see the Office of Student Affairs' rental information[3].

steps.title_zh: 啟用 NID，在 MyFCU 申請床位
steps.title_en: Activate your NID and apply on MyFCU
steps.notes: 先啟用逢甲 NID 帳號，登入 MyFCU，路徑：新生資訊 → 新生必做 → 報到流程檢核 → 宿舍申請[1][2]。2026學年秋季班的申請與繳費時間是2026年8月5日上午9時到8月18日24時[1][2]；2026年春季班申請到2026年1月21日[1]。每年日期不同，請以宿舍服務網站公告為準。
steps.notes_en: First activate your FCU NID account, then log in to MyFCU and go to For New Students → Things to Do → Check List of Registration → Dormitory Application[1][2]. For fall 2026, application and payment run from 9:00 on 5 August to 24:00 on 18 August 2026[1][2]; for spring 2026, applications closed on 21 January 2026[1]. Dates change every year, so follow the notices on the Housing Services website.

steps.title_zh: 線上繳住宿費和保證金
steps.title_en: Pay the housing fee and deposit online
steps.notes: 申請時要先繳一學期住宿費和一學年保證金，可用信用卡或臺灣的 ATM 轉帳[2]。四人雅房住宿費每學期新臺幣19,900元，保證金每學年8,000元[1][2]。保證金用來支付設備損壞，有剩餘會無息退還[2]。繳費後取消床位（包括最後沒有來就讀或休退學），保證金不退還，無法配合的人請不要申請[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: When you apply, pay one semester's housing fee and the deposit for the academic year, by credit card or a Taiwan ATM transfer[2]. A four-person room costs NT$19,900 per semester, and the deposit is NT$8,000 per academic year[1][2]. The deposit covers damage to furniture and fittings; anything left is refunded without interest[2]. If you cancel your bed after paying (including not enrolling or withdrawing), the deposit is not refunded, so don't apply unless you can follow the rules[1][2].

steps.title_zh: 查詢分配結果，列印住宿契約
steps.title_en: Check your room assignment and print the contract
steps.notes: 2026學年秋季班於2026年8月25日下午5時後，再次登入 MyFCU，在「我的申請紀錄」查看床位分配結果，並列印學生宿舍契約書[1][2]。男生分配到福星 I 棟，女生分配到福星 H 棟[2]。
steps.notes_en: For fall 2026, after 17:00 on 25 August 2026, log in to MyFCU again and check your room assignment under My Application Record, then print your student dormitory contract[1][2]. Men are assigned to Fusing Building I and women to Fusing Building H[2].

steps.notes: 2026學年秋季班從2026年8月29日上午9時起可以入住，報到時要帶住宿契約書[1][2]。宿舍不提供寢具，請自備寢具和個人用品[2]。2026年8月31日下午6時有福星宿舍生活公約暨安全講習[1]。寢室電費另計，每度5元，由室友平均分擔，用悠遊卡儲值[1][2]。
steps.notes_en: For fall 2026 you can move in from 9:00 on 29 August 2026; bring your dormitory contract when you check in[1][2]. Bedding is not provided, so bring your own bedding and personal items[2]. The Fusing dorm house rules and safety briefing is at 18:00 on 31 August 2026[1]. Electricity is extra, NT$5 per kWh, shared equally by roommates and paid by topping up an EasyCard[1][2].

steps.notes: 核准入住的學生以住滿一學年為原則，住宿費在每學期開學時各繳一次，學期中搬出不退費[2]。只住一學期要在第一學期結束前辦理退宿，並依「一學期房價」補繳差額[2]。違反宿舍生活公約累計扣滿10分，由中心討論處分，必要時要求立即搬離[2]。
steps.notes_en: Approved residents are expected to stay for the whole academic year. The housing fee is paid at the start of each semester, and moving out mid-semester is not refunded[2]. To stay only one semester, move out before the first semester ends and pay the difference at the one-semester rate[2]. Breaking the dorm rules until 10 points are deducted leads to a penalty decided by the center, and if necessary you will be told to move out immediately[2].

steps.title_zh: 沒有宿舍床位：在校外租屋
steps.title_en: No dorm bed: rent off campus
steps.notes: 逢甲不代為安排校外住宿[4]。學務處「即時賃居（租屋）資訊」整理了學校附近、經生輔組實地檢核的租屋，也有新版賃居網站 house.fcu.edu.tw 和 LINE@ 帳號 @fcu_rent 可一對一詢問；學務處建議一定要親自看屋[5]。國際事務處說明，臺中平均月租約新臺幣7,000到8,500元，另付押金約10,000到15,000元，多數房東押金只收現金，入境時請準備足夠現金[4]。簽約前可參考內政部房屋租賃契約書範本[5]；學伴可以陪你找房，但不能代簽租約[4]。
steps.notes_en: FCU does not arrange off-campus housing[4]. The Office of Student Affairs' real-time rental page lists places near campus that its student life staff have inspected; there is also the new rental website house.fcu.edu.tw and the LINE account @fcu_rent for one-to-one questions. Student Affairs recommends always viewing a place in person[5]. The Office of International Affairs says average rent in Taichung is about NT$7,000 to NT$8,500 a month, plus a deposit of about NT$10,000 to NT$15,000; most landlords take the deposit in cash only, so bring enough cash when you arrive[4]. Before signing, you can refer to the Ministry of the Interior's model lease[5]; your buddy can help you look for a place but cannot sign the lease for you[4].
